journal_lines: No real timber here. Gathered what branches could be found.
Sparse canopy at best. Not worth the axe.
Wrong place for this work. Thin scrub, no proper stands.
Came back with sticks. Nothing here worth felling.
Looked for lumber. Found none. Picked up dead branches on the way back.
A single tree where there should have been a hundred. Took some lower branches and left.
Scrubland gives what scrubland has. It is not much.
Found a dead trunk leaning on a live one. Took the dead one. Asked the live one nothing.
Gathered kindling. Called it kindling on the way home, anyway.
Wrong place, wrong work. Came home lighter than I went out.
